'''Aut-O's flagship''' was a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] that was [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module/Legends|infiltrated]] by the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="SW" /> This flagship carried an [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]] that was needed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to decipher coded transmissions, specifically one sent out by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], that was believed to hold important attack strategies.<ref name="SW" />
